scope.summary: Implement the pre-welded single-mesh export option per Section 13.26 (Part-3 contract, Diffeomorphic merge parity): genital modules welded into the body via the vertex_pairs weld map, boundary-blended textures baked into unified sets, and one material set emitted — so engines never see shells or grafts.
acceptance_criteria: The single-mesh option welds genital module geometry into the body using the region-graft vertex_pairs map (MT-547 mechanism); the output mesh is watertight with no duplicate vertices along the weld seam (validator check).
Boundary-blended albedo/normal textures (MT-558 blend) bake into the unified texture set; no shell geometry or separate blend layers appear in the export.
Exactly one material set is emitted for the body+genitals; UV re-layout (if the profile repacks) preserves the genital-tile texel priority.

The dark-skin blend fixture passes: the baked seam is imperceptible (boundary pixel delta under threshold) on the darkest seeded skin tone, not just white skins (the Golden-Palace complaint as a regression test).
Blendshapes and skinning weights spanning the weld seam survive the merge (a corrective crossing the seam deforms continuously).
scope.risk_if_missed: Engines inherit the Daz geograft mess — visible genital seams, shell hacks that no game pipeline accepts, and texture blends that only work on white skins.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
